How to Use Recruitment Assist on Monster +

CrintellTech Recruitment Assist helps recruiters manage candidate profiles on Monster+, push candidate information into the company database, and identify duplicate profiles.

This article explains the workflow for using Recruitment Assist on Monster+ and highlights its key features.

  1. 1
    Search for Candidates on Monster+

    Log in to Monster+ and search for candidates using the available search options.

  2. 2
    Open a Candidate's Profile
    Select a candidate from the search results to open their LinkedIn profile.
  3. 3
    Push the Candidate Profile to the Database

    Recruitment Assist automatically pushes the candidate's profile when the profile page loads, provided the required details are available.

    Once the profile is successfully pushed, you will see the confirmation notification:

    “Resume is successfully pushed into your database”.

  4. 4
    Add Candidate Notes
    CrintellTech Assist provides a Candidate Notes interface that allows you to attach notes to a candidate's profile within the database.

    Use this feature to record relevant candidate information for future reference.
  5. 1.
    Automated Profile Push

    Candidate profiles are automatically pushed into the database when the required details available.

    2.
    Duplicate Profile Notification

    A duplicate notification appears on the Indeed search results page for candidates already in the database whose profiles were previously parsed through CrintellTech.

  6. 💡Best Practices

    • Ensure you are on the correct Monster+ candidate profile before pushing a resume.

    • Verify that the required details are loaded and available.

    • Check for duplicate profile notifications before proceeding.

    • Refer to the workflow video if you need help identifying the relevant buttons or notifications.
